title: Road closures report - October 30, 2026
body:

Details

Detour
Eastbound - King St S to Allen St E, Westbound - Moore Ave to Allen St

End Date:

Details

University Ave E
From New Bedford Dr to Woolwich Pl

Wednesday, November 4, 2026
End Date:
Thursday, November 5, 2026
Details

Details
